Supporter RetentionJourney

A 12-step SFMC solution designed to identify, reconnect with, and save regular givers showing cancellation intent, so we can keep doing what matters most.

Scroll to explore
Overview Data model Automation Journey Outcomes Reporting Optimise Full flow

Reducing churn after the 3rd donation

This journey identifies regular givers who have completed exactly three donations and are showing early warning signs of disengagement, before they cancel.

Once identified, a personalised multi-channel sequence is triggered: a warm impact email, SMS with a self-service CloudPage, and phone escalation for high-value supporters.

  • Reduce cancellations at the critical 3-gift threshold
  • Offer flexible save options: pause, reduce, or update payment
  • Prioritise human connection for high-value donors via phone queue
  • Build continuous optimisation through A/B testing and predictive scoring

Entry risk signals

Donors enter the journey when they meet the base criteria (3+ gifts, Active status) and show one or more of these risk signals:

Failed payment
Cancellation page visit
No opens in 60 days
Missed recurring gift
Stop donation request
Low engagement score

Field reference

Data Extension field guide

Every field has a job. Here's what each one does and why it matters to the journey logic.

FieldTypePurpose
ContactKey PKTextUnique identifier linking the donor across all SFMC activities and data views
FirstNameTextAMPscript personalisation in emails (%%FirstName%%) and SMS body
EmailAddressEmailSend address for all email activities in Journey Builder
MobileNumberPhoneE.164 format for SMS activity, required for mobile engagement path
DonationAmountDecimalRegular giving amount, used in high-value check (>$50) to route to phone escalation
TotalGiftsNumberCore segmentation field, SQL filters on TotalGifts ≥ 3 to identify journey candidates
LastGiftDateDateRecency signal, donors with no gift in 60+ days flagged at-risk
DonorStatusTextActive / Lapsed / Cancelled, SQL filters on Active only
PreferredChannelTextEmail or SMS, enables channel-first decision split for personalised sequencing
FieldTypePurpose
ContactKey PKTextJoins to Donor Master DE; used as journey entry ContactKey
RiskReasonTextPopulated by SQL: Low Engagement / Failed Payment / Cancellation Intent
TotalGiftsNumberCarried from Donor Master for use in email dynamic content
LastGiftAmountDecimalUsed in personalised impact messaging ("your last gift of $X…")
LastGiftDateDateCarried for recency display in email content
EngagementScoreNumberComposite score used in high-value donor escalation path
CancellationFlagBooleanTrue if cancellation page visit or support request detected
EntryDateDateRecords when the donor entered At-Risk DE for reporting and 90-day re-entry logic
FieldTypePurpose
ContactKey PKTextLinks outcome record back to the donor
OutcomeTextSaved / Cancelled / Inactive, primary reporting dimension
SavedDateDateTimestamp of save event for journey velocity reporting
ReducedDonationDecimalNew reduced amount if donor chose to downgrade rather than cancel
PausedDonationBooleanTrue if donor selected the pause option via CloudPage
CancelledDonationBooleanTrue if cancellation confirmed, seeds future win-back campaign
FieldTypePurpose
ContactKey PKTextDonor identifier passed to the supporter care team
PhoneNumberPhoneMapped from Donor Master MobileNumber at the write step
PriorityLevelTextHigh / Standard, High set for donors meeting escalation criteria
AssignedToTextFundraising team member or queue group assignment
CallStatusTextPending / Called / Saved / No Answer, updated by team after contact

Step 2

Automation Studio

Daily scheduled pipeline that identifies at-risk donors and injects them into the journey.

Step 2a

Automation Studio

SQL Query Activity

SQL Query Activity identifying at-risk donors: TotalGifts ≥ 3, zero email opens in 60 days, Active status.

Step 2b

Automation Studio

Daily scheduled pipeline

Full automation flow: Import Donor Data → SQL Segmentation → Populate At-Risk DE → Inject into Journey. Runs daily at midnight.

Steps 3 – 9

Journey Builder

Multi-channel engagement sequence from entry through to phone escalation.

Step 3

Journey Entry

Entry source configuration

Entry source configured to At_Risk_Donor_DE with 'No re-entry for 90 days' rule preventing repeated journey entry.

Step 4

Email Activity

Email 1, Appreciation + Impact

Email 1 configuration: personalised subject line, AMPscript dynamic content blocks, and CTAs for Pause / Reduce / Update Payment.

Step 5

Wait Activity

3-day engagement window

3-day wait activity giving donors time to act on the impact email before the journey progresses to the decision split.

Step 6

Decision Split

Engagement check, 5 paths

Five-path engagement check: Cancelled · Payment Updated · Clicked Save Link · Opened Email · No Engagement.

Step 7

SMS Activity

SMS with CloudPage link

SMS activity with CloudPage personalisation for donors who didn't engage with Email 1, links to donation adjustment options.

Step 8

Decision Split

Multi-channel check

Multi-channel check after SMS wait: Donation Update · SMS Link Click · Inbound Response · No Engagement.

Step 9

Phone Escalation

High-value supporter escalation to Phone Queue DE

High-value donor check (>$50 or long tenure or high engagement) routes to Phone_Queue_DE with Priority: High.

Step 10

Exit Paths & Outcomes

Saved supporters enter a nurture stream. Cancelled supporters receive a graceful exit and are seeded into a future win-back campaign.

Step 10

Journey Outcomes

Saved donor vs. cancelled donor exit paths

Final outcome split: Saved donors → Thank-You Email → Nurture Stream. Cancelled → Graceful Exit → Feedback → Win-Back Campaign.

Reporting & Tracking

Tracking extracts, data views, and Intelligence Reports to measure what's working and why.
